sql: WITH PassesWithTeams AS ( SELECT p.pass_from, p.pass_to, t1.team_name AS team_from, t2.team_name AS team_to, IF(t1.team_name = t2.team_name, 1, 0) same_team_flag, p.time_stamp FROM Passes p JOIN Teams t1 ON p.pass_from = t1.player_id JOIN Teams t2 ON p.pass_to = t2.player_id ), StreakGroups AS ( SELECT team_from AS team_name, time_stamp, same_team_flag, SUM( CASE WHEN same_team_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY team_from ORDER BY time_stamp ) AS group_id FROM PassesWithTeams ), StreakLengths AS ( SELECT team_name, group_id, COUNT(*) AS streak_length FROM StreakGroups WHERE same_team_flag = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2 ), LongestStreaks AS ( SELECT team_name, MAX(streak_length) AS longest_streak FROM StreakLengths GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT team_name, longest_streak FROM LongestStreaks ORDER BY 1
